Compute balancing allowances and charges on disposal

blocks.en: Paragraphs 63–66 of Schedule 3 ITA define an industrial building; the building must be used for a specified purpose.
blocks.ms: Perenggan 63–66 Jadual 3 ITA mentakrifkan bangunan industri; bangunan mesti digunakan untuk tujuan yang ditetapkan.

blocks.en: Core buildings
blocks.ms: Bangunan teras

en: A factory equipped with plant and machinery to carry out manufacturing
Another building housing machinery or plant for manufacturing, or generating power for manufacturing
A workshop for repair or servicing of goods, if not done in conjunction with, or incidental to, selling those goods
A building in the same compound (same curtilage) used to store raw materials, fuel or stores for manufacture, or to store processed goods before sale

Bangunan lain yang menempatkan jentera atau loji untuk pembuatan, atau menjana kuasa untuk pembuatan

blocks.en: ‘Within the same curtilage’ means a building adjoining or adjacent to, or in the land immediately surrounding, a building used as a factory.
blocks.ms: ‘Dalam curtilage yang sama’ bermaksud bangunan bersebelahan atau berhampiran, atau dalam tanah yang mengelilingi, bangunan yang digunakan sebagai kilang.

en: Licensed private hospital, maternity home, nursing home

en: Building for industrial, technical or vocational training

blocks.en: Slides 21 and 22 contain no readable text (figures).
blocks.ms: Slaid 21 dan 22 tiada teks yang boleh dibaca (rajah).

blocks.en: Dwelling houses, retail shops, showrooms and offices are not IBs. But under para 66 Schedule 3 (Rule 10%), if the office or any area not used as an IB (or rented out) is less than 10% of the QE for constructing or buying the building, allowance is given on the entire building.
blocks.ms: Rumah kediaman, kedai runcit, bilik pameran dan pejabat bukan IB. Namun di bawah para 66 Jadual 3 (Peraturan 10%), jika pejabat atau kawasan bukan IB (atau disewakan) kurang 10% daripada QE pembinaan atau pembelian bangunan, elaun diberi ke atas keseluruhan bangunan.

en: Allowance only on the IB portion (examples: 80% IB when 20% office/showroom)
ms: Elaun hanya atas bahagian IB (contoh: 80% IB apabila 20% pejabat/bilik pameran)

blocks.en: Rule 75%
blocks.ms: Peraturan 75%

blocks.en: If expenditure on preparing, cutting, tunnelling or levelling land to install plant and machinery exceeds 75% of the aggregate of the plant and machinery cost and its installation cost, the total (plant, machinery and installation) is treated as expenditure on a building. If that building is an IB it qualifies for IBA, and the plant and machinery then do not qualify for capital allowance.
blocks.ms: Jika perbelanjaan menyediakan, memotong, menerowong atau meratakan tanah untuk memasang loji dan jentera melebihi 75% daripada jumlah kos loji dan jentera serta kos pemasangannya, keseluruhan (loji, jentera dan pemasangan) dianggap perbelanjaan bangunan. Jika bangunan itu IB, ia layak IBA, dan loji serta jentera tidak layak elaun modal.

blocks.en: Worked check (lecturer’s Q4, Sunrise): machinery 110,060 + installation 45,000 = 155,060; land preparation 30,000. Ratio = 30,000 ÷ (155,060 + 30,000) = 16% which is below 75%, so the machinery is claimed under capital allowances. Showroom + office = 2 of 12 parts = 17% (above 10%) so only the IB share (10/12) qualifies.
blocks.ms: Semakan kerja (S4 pensyarah, Sunrise): jentera 110,060 + pemasangan 45,000 = 155,060; penyediaan tanah 30,000. Nisbah = 30,000 ÷ (155,060 + 30,000) = 16% iaitu di bawah 75%, jadi jentera dituntut di bawah elaun modal. Bilik pameran + pejabat = 2 daripada 12 bahagian = 17% (melebihi 10%) jadi hanya bahagian IB (10/12) layak.

en: Cost of constructing buildings or structures used as IB
ms: Kos membina bangunan atau struktur untuk IB

en: Cost of land and other costs related to land
ms: Kos tanah dan kos lain berkaitan tanah

blocks.en: Also qualifying
blocks.ms: Turut layak

en: Digging and laying foundations for drains, water pipes and electric cables
Cost of preparing plans for local authority approval

Labour, materials, haulage, management, supervision and other overheads
Incidental work such as drainage, water and electricity installation; fittings forming part of the building

Capital expenditure on additions, renovations (including structural changes and improvements) and alterations (an overall change of the original structure)
ms: Menggali dan meletakkan asas untuk longkang, paip air dan kabel elektrik
Kos menyediakan pelan untuk kelulusan pihak berkuasa tempatan
Kos membersihkan tapak lama jika bangunan lama bukan IB
Buruh, bahan, pengangkutan, pengurusan, penyeliaan dan overhed lain
Kerja sampingan seperti saliran, pemasangan air dan elektrik; lekapan yang menjadi sebahagian bangunan
Fi guaman dan duti setem berkaitan bangunan atau struktur
Perbelanjaan modal ke atas tambahan, pengubahsuaian (termasuk perubahan struktur dan penambahbaikan) dan ubahan (perubahan menyeluruh struktur asal)

blocks.en: The slides do not state the rates. The lecturer’s worked answers use an Initial Allowance (IA) of 10% and an Annual Allowance (AA) of 3% of QBE, with residual expenditure (RE) = QBE − allowances given.
blocks.ms: Slaid tidak menyatakan kadar. Jawapan kerja pensyarah menggunakan Elaun Permulaan (IA) 10% dan Elaun Tahunan (AA) 3% daripada QBE, dengan perbelanjaan baki (RE) = QBE − elaun diberi.

en: Qualifying costs (excl. land RM1.2m, RM3,600 land legal fees, RM300,000 demolition of old factory)
Total of stamp duty/legal 10,800 + architect 18,600 + levelling 480,000 + piling 288,000 + wiring 105,600 + internal roads 64,800 + construction 360,000
ms: Kos layak (tolak tanah RM1.2j, fi guaman tanah RM3,600, perobohan kilang lama RM300,000)
Jumlah duti setem/guaman 10,800 + arkitek 18,600 + perataan 480,000 + cerucuk 288,000 + pendawaian 105,600 + jalan dalaman 64,800 + pembinaan 360,000

blocks.en: In the lecturer’s answer the demolition of an old factory (RM300,000) is excluded, which is consistent with slide 24 (site clearing qualifies only if the old building was not an IB). The answer sheet gives no reasoning for this, so that explanation is my reading.
blocks.ms: Dalam jawapan pensyarah, perobohan kilang lama (RM300,000) dikecualikan, selaras dengan slaid 24 (pembersihan tapak layak hanya jika bangunan lama bukan IB). Lembaran jawapan tidak memberi sebab, jadi penjelasan itu bacaan saya.

blocks.en: Purchase of a used building
blocks.ms: Pembelian bangunan terpakai

blocks.en: In the answers the buyer of a building from another IB owner is given QBE = purchase price (land excluded) and, for the buyer, IA is nil with AA 10% (Hikari Sdn Bhd: 135,000 on RM1,350,000; Nangka Bhd: 235,000 on RM2,350,000).
blocks.ms: Dalam jawapan, pembeli bangunan daripada pemilik IB lain diberi QBE = harga belian (tanah dikecualikan) dan, bagi pembeli, IA ialah sifar dengan AA 10% (Hikari Sdn Bhd: 135,000 atas RM1,350,000; Nangka Bhd: 235,000 atas RM2,350,000).

blocks.en: The answer sheet is inconsistent here: Care Maternity Home (a buyer from Remedy Hospital) is given IA 10% and AA 3%, and Nangka’s YA2026 line is labelled 3% but shows 235,000. Treat the 10% purchaser rate as the sheet’s majority approach and confirm with your lecturer before relying on it.
blocks.ms: Lembaran jawapan tidak konsisten di sini: Care Maternity Home (pembeli daripada Remedy Hospital) diberi IA 10% dan AA 3%, dan baris YA2026 Nangka berlabel 3% tetapi menunjukkan 235,000. Anggap kadar pembeli 10% sebagai pendekatan majoriti lembaran, dan sahkan dengan pensyarah sebelum bergantung padanya.

blocks.ms: Nilai pelupusan ialah nilai pasaran pada tarikh jualan, pindah milik atau serah hak, atau hasil jualan.

blocks.en: Cempedak Bhd (lecturer’s Q6): QBE 1,600,000 (2,800,000 − land 1,200,000; the 1/11 office is under 10% so the whole building qualifies). IA 160,000 + AA 48,000 in YA2020, then 4 × 48,000 (YA2021–24); RE 1,200,000. Sold in YA2025 for 3,750,000 − land 1,400,000 = 2,350,000. Excess 1,150,000, but the charge is limited to allowances given: 160,000 + 48,000 + 192,000 = RM400,000.
blocks.ms: Cempedak Bhd (S6 pensyarah): QBE 1,600,000 (2,800,000 − tanah 1,200,000; pejabat 1/11 di bawah 10% jadi seluruh bangunan layak). IA 160,000 + AA 48,000 dalam YA2020, kemudian 4 × 48,000 (YA2021–24); RE 1,200,000. Dijual dalam YA2025 pada 3,750,000 − tanah 1,400,000 = 2,350,000. Lebihan 1,150,000, tetapi caj dihadkan kepada elaun diberi: 160,000 + 48,000 + 192,000 = RM400,000.

blocks.en: Temporary disuse (paras 55 and 57)

blocks.en: An IB temporarily not used for the qualifying trade is deemed to be in use, and annual allowances continue, if it was used for the business immediately before, is kept properly maintained ready for use, and the disuse is only temporary.
